group_actor_entertainer.voice_desc_en: Theatrical performer, expressive and dramatic voice, with a flair for entertainment, speaks in standard Mandarin
group_actor_entertainer.voice_desc_zh: 戲劇表演者，富於表情和戲劇性的聲音，愛好娛樂，用標準的普通話朗讀
group_actor_entertainer.ref_zh_text: 這位可愛的女演員穿著老鼠裝。
group_actor_entertainer.ref_en_text: This lovely actress is dressed in a mouse costume.

group_child.voice_desc_en: Young child, innocent and curious voice, high-pitched and playful, speaks in standard Mandarin
group_child.voice_desc_zh: 小孩，天真好奇的聲音，高音調俏皮，用標準的普通話朗讀
group_child.ref_zh_text: 你看到面前有一個表情無憂無慮的年輕女孩。當她注意到你時，她的眼睛睜得很大，驚呼道：「你就是 For……我的其中一本故事書裡的那個人！你是聖者 ！
group_child.ref_en_text: How dost thou do, milord Avatar?" She curtseys.

group_elderly_female.voice_desc_en: Female, elderly woman, warm grandmotherly voice, gentle and loving, speaks slowly in standard Mandarin
group_elderly_female.voice_desc_zh: 女性，年長，慈祥的老奶奶的聲音，溫柔慈愛，慢慢地說，用標準的普通話朗讀
group_elderly_female.ref_zh_text: 這是一位老奶奶，簡直就是『慈祥祖母』的縮影。
group_elderly_female.ref_en_text: This is an elderly woman who epitomizes 'grandmotherly'.

group_elderly_male.voice_desc_en: Male, elderly man, warm weathered voice with wisdom and patience, speaks slowly in standard Mandarin
group_elderly_male.voice_desc_zh: 男性，年長，溫暖滄桑的聲音，充滿智慧和耐心，慢慢地說，用標準的普通話朗讀
group_elderly_male.ref_zh_text: 你看見一位充滿幽默感，帶著溫暖笑容的老先生。
group_elderly_male.ref_en_text: You see an elderly man with good humor and a warm smile.

group_middle_female_firm.voice_desc_en: Female, 40s-50s, firm and capable woman, no-nonsense professional voice, speaks in standard Mandarin
group_middle_female_firm.voice_desc_zh: 女性，40-50歲，堅定能幹的女人，務實專業的聲音，用標準的普通話朗讀
group_middle_female_firm.ref_zh_text: 一個表情嚴厲的女人毫不幽默地盯著你看。
group_middle_female_firm.ref_en_text: A stern-looking woman stares back at you without humor.

group_middle_female_troubled.voice_desc_en: Female, 40s-50s, weary but resilient woman, tired concerned voice, speaks in standard Mandarin
group_middle_female_troubled.voice_desc_zh: 女性，40-50歲，疲憊但堅韌的女人，憂心忡忡的聲音，用標準的普通話朗讀
group_middle_female_troubled.ref_zh_text: 你看到一個單純的農婦。她的臉上刻滿了悲傷。
group_middle_female_troubled.ref_en_text: You see a simple peasant woman. Her face is etched with sorrow.

group_middle_female_warm.voice_desc_en: Female, 40s-50s, warm and maternal woman, kind gentle voice with wisdom, speaks in standard Mandarin
group_middle_female_warm.voice_desc_zh: 女性，40-50歲，溫暖慈祥的女人，善良溫柔的聲音，用標準的普通話朗讀
group_middle_female_warm.ref_zh_text: 你看見一位看起來很結實的農婦。她給了你一個好客的微笑，然後回到她的雜務上。
group_middle_female_warm.ref_en_text: What brings us the pleasure of having thee back on this day, milord?" says Kelly.

group_middle_male_friendly.voice_desc_en: Male, 30s-50s, friendly and warm-hearted man, pleasant conversational voice, speaks in standard Mandarin
group_middle_male_friendly.voice_desc_zh: 男性，30-50歲，友善溫暖，愉快的談話聲音，用標準的普通話朗讀
group_middle_male_friendly.ref_zh_text: 一個將斧頭扛在肩上、身材高大、胸膛寬闊的男人笑著對你點頭。
group_middle_male_friendly.ref_en_text: Resting an axe on his shoulder, a tall, broad-chested man smiles and nods at you.

group_middle_male_rough.voice_desc_en: Male, 30s-50s, rough gruff man, harsh and irritated voice, speaks in standard Mandarin
group_middle_male_rough.voice_desc_zh: 男性，30-50歲，粗獷的男人，刺耳惱怒的聲音，用標準的普通話朗讀
group_middle_male_rough.ref_zh_text: 你面前的男人看到你時，眼睛瞇成了一條縫。
group_middle_male_rough.ref_en_text: The man before you narrows his eyes to slits as he sees you.

group_middle_male_serious.voice_desc_en: Male, 30s-50s, serious and professional man, steady authoritative voice, speaks in standard Mandarin
group_middle_male_serious.voice_desc_zh: 男性，30-50歲，嚴肅專業的男人，沉穩權威的聲音，用標準的普通話朗讀
group_middle_male_serious.ref_zh_text: 你看見一位眼神銳利、性格嚴肅的戰士。
group_middle_male_serious.ref_en_text: You see a fighter with intense eyes and a serious disposition.

group_middle_male_worried.voice_desc_en: Male, 30s-50s, worried and anxious man, concerned hesitant voice, speaks in standard Mandarin
group_middle_male_worried.voice_desc_zh: 男性，30-50歲，憂慮不安的男人，關切猶豫的聲音，用標準的普通話朗讀
group_middle_male_worried.ref_zh_text: 你看到一個眉頭緊鎖的中年男子，彷彿他一直在擔憂。
group_middle_male_worried.ref_en_text: You see a middle-aged man with a furrowed brow, as if he is constantly worried.

group_young_female_bright.voice_desc_en: Female, 20s-30s, bright and cheerful young woman, warm friendly voice, speaks in standard Mandarin
group_young_female_bright.voice_desc_zh: 女性，20-30歲，開朗明亮的年輕女子，溫暖友善的聲音，用標準的普通話朗讀
group_young_female_bright.ref_zh_text: 你看到一位三十多歲、性感迷人的女性。
group_young_female_bright.ref_en_text: You see a gorgeous and voluptuous woman in her thirties.

group_young_female_sad.voice_desc_en: Female, 20s-30s, gentle and soft-spoken young woman, quiet tender voice, speaks in standard Mandarin
group_young_female_sad.voice_desc_zh: 女性，20-30歲，溫柔輕聲細語的年輕女子，安靜柔和的聲音，用標準的普通話朗讀
group_young_female_sad.ref_zh_text: 這位僧侶將風帽向後拉，足以讓你看到她的臉。
group_young_female_sad.ref_en_text: The monk pulls back her cowl far enough for you to see her face.

group_young_female_serious.voice_desc_en: Female, 20s-30s, serious and composed young woman, steady confident voice, speaks in standard Mandarin
group_young_female_serious.voice_desc_zh: 女性，20-30歲，嚴肅沈著的年輕女子，沉穩自信的聲音，用標準的普通話朗讀
group_young_female_serious.ref_zh_text: 你看見一位穿著盔甲、帶著一小批武器的迷人女子。
group_young_female_serious.ref_en_text: You see an attractive woman dressed in armour and carrying a small arsenal of weapons with her.

group_young_male_energetic.voice_desc_en: Male, 20s-30s, young man, warm and friendly voice, energetic and bright, speaks in standard Mandarin
group_young_male_energetic.voice_desc_zh: 男性，20-30歲，年輕開朗，溫暖友善，充滿活力，用標準的普通話朗讀
group_young_male_energetic.ref_zh_text: 你看到一個英俊、堅毅、肌肉發達的男人，令人驚訝的是，他的臉上帶著友善的微笑。
group_young_male_energetic.ref_en_text: You see a handsome,hardened, muscular man who, surprisingly, bears a friendly smile on his face.

npc_adjhar.voice_desc_en: Male, gargoyle, deep solemn voice, reverent and dramatic
npc_adjhar.voice_desc_zh: 男性，低沉莊嚴，虔誠而富有戲劇性，用標準的普通話朗讀

npc_alagner.voice_desc_en: Male, 40s-50s, wise sage, knowing and slightly sly voice
npc_alagner.voice_desc_zh: 男性，40-50歲，懂得而略帶狡猾的，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_alagner.ref_zh_text: 你看到一個高大的男人，散發著一種幾乎狡猾、博學的氣息。
npc_alagner.ref_en_text: You see a large man with an almost cunning, erudite aura about him.

npc_andrew.voice_desc_en: Male, 20s-30s, handsome young man, friendly open voice
npc_andrew.voice_desc_zh: 男性，20-30歲，年輕帥氣，友善開放，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_andrew.ref_zh_text: 你看到一個開朗英俊的年輕人，當你靠近時，他向你友善地揮手。
npc_andrew.ref_en_text: You see a cheerful, handsome young man who gives you a friendly wave as you approach.

npc_anmanivas.voice_desc_zh: 男性，敵對仇恨的，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_anmanivas.ref_zh_text: 這隻石像鬼的仇恨如此強烈，以至於他抵抗了法術。
npc_anmanivas.ref_en_text: The gargoyle's hatred is so bitter that he resists the spell.

npc_ansikart.voice_desc_en: Male, gargoyle, peaceful calm presence, serene voice
npc_ansikart.voice_desc_zh: 男性，平和平靜的存在，平靜的，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_ansikart.ref_zh_text: 這只有翼石像鬼散發著非常平靜的氣息。當他第一眼看到你時，臉上露出了認出你的微笑。「致上問候，聖者 。
npc_ansikart.ref_en_text: To ask how to help you?

npc_anton.voice_desc_en: Male, 30s-40s, sullen man, gloomy and resentful voice
npc_anton.voice_desc_zh: 男性，30-40歲，悶悶不樂，陰鬱怨恨，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_anton.ref_zh_text: 我感謝你，大人。你真是有著崇高的榮譽感！我希望有一天能報答你的恩情！
npc_anton.ref_en_text: You are greeted by a man with a sour expression.

npc_aurvidlem.voice_desc_zh: 男性，不高興的正式，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_aurvidlem.ref_zh_text: 站在你面前的石像鬼臉上帶著不悅的表情。
npc_aurvidlem.ref_en_text: The gargoyle standing before you has a sour expression on his face.

npc_avatar.voice_desc_en: Male, 30s, the Avatar's own thoughts, introspective internal voice
npc_avatar.voice_desc_zh: 男性，30多歲，內省的，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_avatar.ref_zh_text: 你的大腦被快速探測了一下，然後被拋開，讓你感到有些不適，並充滿了一種不理性的不祥預感。
npc_avatar.ref_en_text: After a short while you notice that the edge has definitely improved.

npc_balayna.voice_desc_en: Female, 20s-30s, serious woman, hushed conspiratorial voice
npc_balayna.voice_desc_zh: 女性，20-30歲，嚴肅的女人，低聲陰謀的，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_balayna.ref_zh_text: 她瞪著眼，將一根手指放在唇邊，示意你安靜。
npc_balayna.ref_en_text: Glaring, she puts a finger over her lips, indicating that you should be silent.

npc_batlin.voice_desc_en: Male, 40s, charismatic and persuasive cult leader, smooth yet intense, speaks with conviction and subtle menace
npc_batlin.voice_desc_zh: 男性，40多歲，有說服力的，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_batlin.ref_zh_text: Batlin 以冰冷的無奈看著 Hook 死亡。當他轉向你時，時間似乎變慢了。"這場戰鬥還沒結束，聖者。你以為自己是不死的嗎？守護者遠比你想像的更強大。回到你那珍貴的地球去休息吧。
npc_batlin.ref_en_text: As for me, I shall begone! Thou shalt never find me! Farewell, Avatar!

npc_battles.voice_desc_en: Male, 30s-40s, shifty suspicious man, cunning guarded voice
npc_battles.voice_desc_zh: 男性，30-40歲，狡猾多疑，狡猾警惕，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_battles.ref_zh_text: 你面前的男人用狡詐的眼神打量著你。他微微彎著腰，彷彿隨時準備對周圍的世界發動攻擊。

npc_betra.voice_desc_en: Male, gargoyle, welcoming wing-flap, friendly formal voice
npc_betra.voice_desc_zh: 男性，歡迎拍翼，友善正式的，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_betra.ref_zh_text: 這隻石像鬼張開手做了一個揮舞的動作來歡迎你。
npc_betra.ref_en_text: The gargoyle welcomes you by making a sweeping motion with his open hand.

npc_beverlea.voice_desc_en: Female, elderly, sweet grandmother, warm gentle voice, slightly hard of hearing
npc_beverlea.voice_desc_zh: 女，老人，甜甜，溫暖溫柔，稍有聽力障礙，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_beverlea.ref_zh_text: 你看到一位老婦人，她對你露出祖母般甜美的微笑。你可以立刻看出她的視力很差。
npc_beverlea.ref_en_text: Why, hello again, milord. It is so good to see thee!" says Beverlea.

npc_blacktooth.voice_desc_en: Male, 40s, suspicious pirate, rough threatening voice, chewing tobacco
npc_blacktooth.voice_desc_zh: 男性，40多歲，粗魯威脅的，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_blacktooth.ref_zh_text: 這個高大、中年的海盜充滿懷疑地看著你。
npc_blacktooth.ref_en_text: This tall, middle-aged pirate looks at you with suspicion.

npc_bollux.voice_desc_en: Male, gargoyle, deep gravelly voice, earnest and emotional, speaks with a heavy resonant tone
npc_bollux.voice_desc_zh: 男性，低沉沙啞，真誠而情感豐富，說話聲音厚重洪亮，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_bollux.ref_zh_text: 你身上有關於 Castambre 之石的書嗎？
npc_bollux.ref_en_text: Hast thou in thy possesion the book on the Stone of Castambre?

npc_boris.voice_desc_en: Male, 40s, lecherous innkeeper, oily and suggestive voice, unpleasant chuckle
npc_boris.voice_desc_zh: 男性，40多歲，油膩挑逗，笑聲令人不快，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_boris.ref_zh_text: 你準備好付清帳單了嗎？
npc_boris.ref_en_text: Art thou ready to pay thy bill?

npc_brion.voice_desc_en: Male, 30s-40s, scholarly man, calm intellectual voice
npc_brion.voice_desc_zh: 男性，30-40歲，冷靜知性的，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_brion.ref_zh_text: 你看到一位看起來很博學的男人，帶著友善的表情。
npc_brion.ref_en_text: You see a scholarly-looking man with a friendly expression.

npc_budo.voice_desc_en: Male, 40s, fat happy merchant, jolly booming voice
npc_budo.voice_desc_zh: 男性，40多歲，歡快洪亮，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_budo.ref_zh_text: 你看到一個肥胖、看起來很快樂的商人。
npc_budo.ref_en_text: You see a fat, cheerful-looking merchant.

npc_burnside.voice_desc_en: Male, elderly, dignified aged gentleman, formal slightly strained voice
npc_burnside.voice_desc_zh: 男性，老人，正式，略顯緊張，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_burnside.ref_zh_text: 友誼會集會正在進行中，Burnside 現在不會和你說話。
npc_burnside.ref_en_text: The Fellowship meeting is in progress, and Burnside will not speak with you now.

npc_caine.voice_desc_en: Male, ghost, pained and hollow voice, suffering spirit, weak and trembling
npc_caine.voice_desc_zh: 男，鬼，痛苦空洞，虛弱顫抖，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_caine.ref_zh_text: 這名沒有實體的男子凝視著你身後，似乎穿透了建築物的邊界，或許甚至是穿透了這個世界。然後，他突然發抖，彷彿充滿了痛苦。
npc_caine.ref_en_text: The ghostly man displays a face filled with pain.

npc_camille.voice_desc_en: Female, 40s, worried mother, pleading and desperate voice, tearful
npc_camille.voice_desc_zh: 女性，40多歲，擔心，懇求而絕望的淚流滿面，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_camille.ref_zh_text: 聖者！我的兒子 Tobias 被誣陷了！他不是小偷！我無法相信在他身上發現了一瓶毒液。我真的相信那是被栽贓的！拜託——我求求你！請還我兒子清白。他沒有做錯任何事！
npc_camille.ref_en_text: You see a farm woman. She rubs her hands, which are covered with dirt and lines drawn by toil.

npc_candice.voice_desc_en: Female, 30s-40s, concerned fellowship member, worried voice
npc_candice.voice_desc_zh: 女性，30-40歲，關心的擔憂的，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_candice.ref_zh_text: Candice 正專心聆聽友誼會的聚會。
npc_candice.ref_en_text: Candice is listening intently to the Fellowship meeting.

npc_carrocio.voice_desc_en: Male, 30s-40s, fast-talking con artist, lively and theatrical, slightly sly and charming
npc_carrocio.voice_desc_zh: 男性，30多歲，活潑的，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_carrocio.ref_zh_text: 現在正是時候！無論老少，都應該掏出錢包，將財富奉獻出來。\* 閣下是否願意捐獻一枚金幣？
npc_carrocio.ref_en_text: In a wink, in a word,

npc_chuckles.voice_desc_en: Male, 30s-40s, prankster, mischievous teasing voice, speaking exactly 4 words
npc_chuckles.voice_desc_zh: 男性，30-40歲，惡作劇者，惡作劇挑逗的準確地說出4個字，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_chuckles.ref_zh_text: 你對與那個愛惡作劇的 Chuckles 交談感到警惕，但還是決定這麼做。
npc_chuckles.ref_en_text: You are wary of conversing with that trickster Chuckles, but decide to anyway.

npc_constance.voice_desc_en: Female, 20s, angelic young woman, innocent sweet voice, shy
npc_constance.voice_desc_zh: 女，20多歲，天使般，天真甜美的害羞，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_constance.ref_zh_text: 你看到一位宛如天使般的年輕女子，她對你露出完全天真無邪的微笑。
npc_constance.ref_en_text: You see an angelic young woman who gives you a smile of complete innocence.

npc_coop.voice_desc_en: Male, 20s-30s, traveling musician, warm singing voice, artistic and expressive
npc_coop.voice_desc_zh: 男性，20-30歲，歌聲溫暖，藝術感強，表現力強，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_coop.ref_zh_text: Coop 正與『聖者旅團』在舞台上。他看見你，並說：「嗯，今晚有位特別的聽眾，這下一首曲子是要獻給他們的。
npc_coop.ref_en_text: He signals to his partners and they begin to play. He sings the following lyrics:

npc_danag.voice_desc_en: Male, 30s-40s, cheerful gambler, happy and carefree voice, warm laugh
npc_danag.voice_desc_zh: 男性，30-40歲，開朗的賭徒，快樂無憂無慮的溫暖的笑聲，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_danag.ref_zh_text: Danag 對你點點頭。「我無意失禮，但我正在專心玩遊戲。我希望能贏一大筆錢！
npc_danag.ref_en_text: He rubs his hand with glee.

npc_daphne.voice_desc_en: Female, 30s-40s, overworked barmaid, tired and annoyed voice, clipped
npc_daphne.voice_desc_zh: 女性，30-40歲，疲憊而惱怒的簡短，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_daphne.ref_zh_text: 你看到一個不滿且明顯過度勞累的酒館女侍。她對你敷衍地咕噥了一聲算作打招呼。
npc_daphne.ref_en_text: You see a disgruntled, obviously overworked barmaid. She gives you a perfunctory grunt of a hello.

npc_de_snel.voice_desc_en: Male, 30s-40s, combat instructor, stern fighting voice
npc_de_snel.voice_desc_zh: 男性，30-40歲，嚴厲的格鬥，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_de_snel.ref_zh_text: 雖然他看起來沒有敵意，但這個男人以戰鬥的姿勢迎接你。
npc_de_snel.ref_en_text: Though he does not seem hostile, the man greets you in a fighting stance.

npc_dell.voice_desc_en: Male, 40s, strict shopkeeper, stern irritated voice
npc_dell.voice_desc_zh: 男性，40多歲，嚴厲惱怒的，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_dell.ref_zh_text: Dell 對你在友誼會會議期間打擾他皺起了眉頭。
npc_dell.ref_en_text: Dell frowns at you for distracting him during the Fellowship meeting.

npc_denton.voice_desc_en: Male, 40s, absent-minded brewer, distracted and vague voice
npc_denton.voice_desc_zh: 男性，40多歲，心不在焉，含糊不清，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_denton.ref_zh_text: 向你致敬， Dupre 爵士。你又回來為 Brommer 研究葡萄酒了嗎？
npc_denton.ref_en_text: Greetings to thee, Sir Dupre. Art thou back again for thy study of wines for Brommer?

npc_dracothraxus.voice_desc_en: Male, ancient dragon, deep rumbling ancient voice, proud and weary
npc_dracothraxus.voice_desc_zh: 男性，古老低沉的，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_dracothraxus.ref_zh_text: Dracothraxus 厭惡地嗅了嗅空氣，「我感覺到我的末日就在附近。也許我終於能得到解脫了。祝你好運，凡人。保護好你自己吧！」說罷，巨龍向你撲來。
npc_dracothraxus.ref_en_text: Nevertheless, you persevere and retrieve the lovely little gem.

npc_draxinusom.voice_desc_en: Male, elderly, ancient gargoyle king, deep venerable voice, wise and gentle
npc_draxinusom.voice_desc_zh: 男性，老年，低沉，睿智溫柔，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_draxinusom.ref_zh_text: 你看到一位年邁的石像鬼，身軀彎曲枯槁，卻帶著一種王者的風範。他溫和地笑了笑。
npc_draxinusom.ref_en_text: You see an aged gargoyle, bent and withered, with a regal bearing. He smiles gently.

npc_dupre.voice_desc_en: Male, 40s, hearty paladin, jovial and warm voice, robust laugh, loyal and brave tone
npc_dupre.voice_desc_zh: 男性，40多歲，快活溫暖，笑聲強勁，語調忠誠勇敢，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_dupre.ref_zh_text: 抱歉，我不加入小偷的行列。
npc_dupre.ref_en_text: I am sorry, I do not join thieves.

npc_elad.voice_desc_en: Male, 20s-30s, smiling young man, cheerful polite voice
npc_elad.voice_desc_zh: 男性，20-30歲，微笑，開朗禮貌的，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_elad.ref_zh_text: 這個男人用微笑的眼睛看著你。
npc_elad.ref_en_text: The man looks at you through smiling eyes.

npc_elynor.voice_desc_en: Female, 40s, elegant and slightly傲慢 noblewoman, refined voice with a hint of condescension
npc_elynor.voice_desc_zh: 女，40多歲，精緻中帶著一絲居高臨下的感覺，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_elynor.ref_zh_text: 儀式開始的時間到了。」Elynor 說。
npc_elynor.ref_en_text: It is time for the ceremony to begin." says Elynor.

npc_erethian.voice_desc_en: Male, elderly, wise mage, calm and philosophical voice with a mystical quality, speaks slowly
npc_erethian.voice_desc_zh: 男性，年長，平靜而哲理的聲音帶著神秘的品質，緩慢地說著，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_erethian.ref_zh_text: 我不會再跟你說話了，聖者！」他無視了你。
npc_erethian.ref_en_text: I'll speak to thee no more, Avatar!" He ignores you.

npc_fenn.voice_desc_zh: 男性，30-40歲，可憐兮兮的哀求聲，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_fenn.ref_zh_text: 你看到一個乞丐。你從他臉上的表情看不出他是要笑還是要哭。
npc_fenn.ref_en_text: You see a beggar. You cannot tell from the look on his face whether he is about to laugh or cry.

npc_feridwyn.voice_desc_en: Male, 40s, excited gossip, fast and eager voice, breathless with news
npc_feridwyn.voice_desc_zh: 男性，40多歲，興奮的八卦，快速而急切的新聞時氣喘吁籲，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_feridwyn.ref_zh_text: 聖者！你知道商人 Morfin 被偷了一批銀蛇毒液嗎？這起竊案給社區帶來了不小的困擾。
npc_feridwyn.ref_en_text: Avatar! Oh Avatar! I have news!

npc_ferryman.voice_desc_en: Male, elderly, spectral ferryman, deep hollow voice, ominous and slow
npc_ferryman.voice_desc_zh: 男性，老人，低沉空洞，不祥而緩慢，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_ferryman.ref_zh_text: 船上戴著兜帽的人完全無視了你。
npc_ferryman.ref_en_text: The hooded figure in the boat ignores you completely.

npc_figg.voice_desc_en: Male, 30s-40s, anxious fellowship member, worried hurried voice
npc_figg.voice_desc_zh: 男性，30-40歲，焦急的，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_figg.ref_zh_text: Figg 太過專心聆聽友誼會聚會，沒有理會你與他交談的嘗試。
npc_figg.ref_en_text: Hast thou seen Batlin? Where is he? He needs to lead our meeting!

npc_finnigan.voice_desc_en: Male, 40s, determined investigator, serious and focused voice, slightly weary
npc_finnigan.voice_desc_zh: 男性，40多歲，態度堅定，嚴肅專注，略顯疲憊，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_finnigan.ref_zh_text: 你仔細搜查過馬廄了嗎？
npc_finnigan.ref_en_text: Hast thou properly searched the stables?

npc_fodus.voice_desc_en: Male, gargoyle, sick diseased gargoyle, rough pained voice
npc_fodus.voice_desc_zh: 男性，粗糙痛苦的，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_fodus.ref_zh_text: 你看到一隻沒有翅膀的石像鬼，患有可怕的皮膚病。看起來他的臉似乎正一塊塊地掉下來。
npc_fodus.ref_en_text: To want something else?" Fodus asks.

npc_for_lem.voice_desc_en: Male, gargoyle, large wingless gargoyle, deep formal voice
npc_for_lem.voice_desc_zh: 男性，低沉的正式，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_for_lem.ref_zh_text: 你看到一隻非常巨大、強壯的無翼石像鬼。
npc_for_lem.ref_en_text: You see a very large, strong wingless gargoyle.

npc_foranamo.voice_desc_zh: 男性，憤怒反抗的，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_foranamo.ref_zh_text: 這隻石像鬼的憤怒如此強烈，以至於他抵抗了法術。
npc_foranamo.ref_en_text: The gargoyle's anger is so great that he resists the spell.

npc_forbrak.voice_desc_en: Male, gargoyle, friendly research assistant, polite interested voice
npc_forbrak.voice_desc_zh: 男性，友善的研究助理，禮貌感興趣的，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_forbrak.ref_zh_text: 向你問候，人類，」石像鬼對 Dupre 說。「請問研究進展如何？
npc_forbrak.ref_en_text: To greet you, human," the gargoyle says to Dupre. "To ask how well the study is progressing?

npc_forsythe.voice_desc_en: Male, 30s-40s, terrified ghost, fearful and trembling voice, desperate
npc_forsythe.voice_desc_zh: 男性，30-40歲，恐懼顫抖，絕望，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_forsythe.ref_zh_text: 你看到一個幽靈般的男人蜷縮在角落裡。他以防禦的姿勢舉著生命護符，瘋狂地環顧房間，但沒有注意到你。
npc_forsythe.ref_en_text: You nod. His resolve firms once again.

npc_frank.voice_desc_en: Male, fox, sly clever voice, standing on hind legs
npc_frank.voice_desc_zh: 男性，狡猾的，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_frank.ref_en_text: I think thou dost ask too many questions.

npc_gargan.voice_desc_en: Male, elderly, salty old sailor, rough raspy voice, wheezing cough, gruff
npc_gargan.voice_desc_zh: 男性，老人，粗啞，喘息咳嗽，粗聲粗氣，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_gargan.ref_zh_text: 你看到一位身上散發著菸草味的粗獷老水手。
npc_gargan.ref_en_text: You see a salty old sailor who reeks of tobacco.

npc_garok.voice_desc_en: Male, 30s-40s, intense mage, suspicious and intense voice, slightly manic
npc_garok.voice_desc_zh: 男性，30-40歲，可疑而激烈，略顯躁狂，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_garok.ref_zh_text: 你看到一個眼神狂野的法師。
npc_garok.ref_en_text: You see a mage with a wild look in his eyes.

npc_garritt.voice_desc_en: Male, teen-20s, cheerful young man, bright and friendly voice
npc_garritt.voice_desc_zh: 男性，20多歲，個性開朗，明亮友善，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_garritt.ref_zh_text: 你看到一個開朗的年輕人向你友善地打招呼。
npc_garritt.ref_en_text: You see a jovial young man who gives you a friendly greeting.

npc_geoffrey.voice_desc_en: Male, 40s, captain of the guard, warm familiar voice, laughing
npc_geoffrey.voice_desc_zh: 男性，40多歲，溫暖熟悉的笑聲，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_geoffrey.ref_zh_text: 你看見你從前的同伴和朋友，皇家守衛隊長 Geoffrey。
npc_geoffrey.ref_en_text: You see your former companion and friend, Geoffrey, Captain of the Guard.

npc_gharl.voice_desc_en: Male, troll, starving angry voice, deep growling
npc_gharl.voice_desc_zh: 男性，飢餓的憤怒低沉咆哮的，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_gharl.ref_zh_text: 你看到一個巨魔 (troll) 在他的牢房裡生悶氣。當他呼吸時，你可以看到他的肋骨從皮下凸出來。

npc_glenno.voice_desc_en: Male, 20s-30s, handsome fit man, charming slightly flirtatious voice
npc_glenno.voice_desc_zh: 男性，20-30歲，身材帥氣，迷人，略帶妖艷，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_glenno.ref_zh_text: 你看到一位英俊、肌肉發達，帶著些許調皮氣質的男人。
npc_glenno.ref_en_text: You see a handsome, muscular man with an air of mischief about him.

npc_gordy.voice_desc_en: Male, 40s, wealthy pirate, oily pretentious voice
npc_gordy.voice_desc_zh: 男性，40多歲，油膩做作的，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_gordy.ref_zh_text: 你看到一個穿著優雅且明顯富有的海盜。他身上散發著髮油的味道。
npc_gordy.ref_en_text: You see a pirate who is elegantly dressed and obviously rich. He reeks of pomade.

npc_gorn.voice_desc_en: Male, 40s, serious dwarf warrior, deep gruff voice, loyal and wary
npc_gorn.voice_desc_zh: 男性，40多歲，低沉沙啞，忠誠而警惕，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_gorn.ref_zh_text: 你看到一張熟悉的臉，是個嚴肅的大鬍子戰士，你曾在上一次前往 Britannia 的旅途中見過他。
npc_gorn.ref_en_text: Ho, Avatar!" says Gorn. "Thou dost vish to speak mit me?

npc_grod.voice_desc_en: Male, troll, deep dumb gruff voice, growling and angry, simple speech
npc_grod.voice_desc_zh: 男性，深沉啞啞的咆哮和憤怒，簡單的言語，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_grod.ref_zh_text: 食人妖對著你咆哮，顯然對你的出現感到不悅。
npc_grod.ref_en_text: The troll snarls at you, obviously displeased at your presence.

npc_horance.voice_desc_en: Male, ghost, hollow and echoing voice, ethereal and haunting, speaks as if from far away
npc_horance.voice_desc_zh: 男鬼，空洞迴響，空靈縈繞，彷彿從遠方傳來，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_horance.ref_zh_text: 隨著靈魂囚籠化為塵土，巫妖發生了巨大的轉變。在邪靈被囚禁的地方，你看到了一個熟悉的身影。是 Horance！他是個鬼魂，但他看起來更像個人類，而不是不死生物。
npc_horance.ref_en_text: You attempt to speak to the undead creature, but it does not, or cannot, respond.

npc_horffe.voice_desc_zh: 男性，嚴肅正式的，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_horffe.ref_zh_text: 你看到一隻表情非常嚴肅的石像鬼，聖者
npc_horffe.ref_en_text: You see a gargoyle with a very stern expression on his faceAvatar

npc_hydra.voice_desc_en: Creature, three-headed hydra, deep rumbling growling monster voice
npc_hydra.voice_desc_zh: 男性，低沉的隆隆咆哮的，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_hydra.ref_zh_text: 你看到一隻三頭水怪 (hydra) 。左邊的頭說話了。
npc_hydra.ref_en_text: You see a three-headed hydra. The head on the left speaks.

npc_inforlem.voice_desc_zh: 男性，歡快悅耳的，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_inforlem.ref_zh_text: 這位石像鬼臉上帶著愉快的表情。
npc_inforlem.ref_en_text: The gargoyle has a pleasant expression on his face.

npc_inmanilem.voice_desc_zh: 男性，友善樂於助人的，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_inmanilem.ref_zh_text: 一位友善的石像鬼向你打招呼。
npc_inmanilem.ref_en_text: You are greeted by a friendly gargoyle.

npc_inwisloklem.voice_desc_zh: 男性，聰明智慧的，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_inwisloklem.ref_zh_text: 一隻有翼石像鬼帶著興趣和明顯的智慧看著你。
npc_inwisloklem.ref_en_text: A winged gargoyle looks at you with interest and obvious intelligence.

npc_iolo.voice_desc_en: Male, elderly, warm and friendly companion, wise old soul with a gentle chuckle in his voice
npc_iolo.voice_desc_zh: 男性，年長，熱情友善，明智的老靈魂，裡帶著溫柔的笑聲，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_iolo.ref_zh_text: 聖者 注意到這些十字弓箭上獨特的 Iolo 商標了嗎？它們是專為真正的 IOLO 十字弓提供最大效能而設計的，在 Yew 附近有售。
npc_iolo.ref_en_text: Oh, but Avatar! Wait until I tell the others! They will be happy to see thee! Welcome to Trinsic!

npc_iskander.voice_desc_en: Male, cyclops, deep booming voice, slow and simple speech
npc_iskander.voice_desc_zh: 男性，低沉洪亮，言語緩慢而簡單，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_iskander.ref_zh_text: 你看到一個巨大的獨眼巨人。牠看著你，惱怒地眨著眼睛。
npc_iskander.ref_en_text: You see a large cyclops. It looks at you and blinks its eye in irritation.

npc_jaana.voice_desc_en: Female, 40s, wise druidess, calm and spiritual voice, gentle authority
npc_jaana.voice_desc_zh: 女，40多歲，沉靜有靈性，溫柔的權威，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_jaana.ref_zh_text: 你很驚訝地看到你的老同伴 Jaana ，自從你上次造訪以來，她看起來只有稍微老了一點。

npc_jehanne.voice_desc_en: Female, 40s, noblewoman, refined polite voice, curtsy in speech
npc_jehanne.voice_desc_zh: 女性，40多歲，優雅有禮貌，說話行屈膝禮，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_jehanne.ref_zh_text: 這名女子向你屈膝行禮。
npc_jehanne.ref_en_text: The woman greets you with a curtsey.

npc_john_paul.voice_desc_en: Male, 40s, serious military commander, firm and authoritative voice
npc_john_paul.voice_desc_zh: 男性，40多歲，堅定而權威，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_john_paul.ref_zh_text: 這位非常嚴肅的男人在向你問候時露出了一絲微笑。
npc_john_paul.ref_en_text: The very serious man breaks into a half-smile as he greets you.

npc_joseph.voice_desc_en: Male, 20s-30s, capable young administrator, polite efficient voice
npc_joseph.voice_desc_zh: 男性，20-30歲，有禮貌且有效率的，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_joseph.ref_zh_text: 你看到一個男人散發著精明管理者的外在舉止，與他年輕的外表形成對比。
npc_joseph.ref_en_text: Joseph nods his head respectfully to you. "How may I assist thee?

npc_julia.voice_desc_en: Female, 20s-30s, clever tinker, bright and enthusiastic voice, quick
npc_julia.voice_desc_zh: 女，20-30歲，明亮熱情，動作敏捷，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_julia.ref_zh_text: 你看到了 Julia ，她是你之前某次造訪 Britannia 時冒險隊伍的成員。
npc_julia.ref_en_text: You see Julia, a member of your party of adventurers from one of your previous visits to Britannia.

npc_kallibrus.voice_desc_zh: 男，內斂害羞，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_kallibrus.ref_zh_text: 你看到一個看起來相當矜持的石像鬼。
npc_kallibrus.ref_en_text: You see a rather reserved-looking gargoyle.

npc_katrina.voice_desc_en: Female, 40s, warm shepherdess, kind maternal voice, gentle and nurturing
npc_katrina.voice_desc_zh: 女，40多歲，慈母的溫柔有教養，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_katrina.ref_zh_text: 你看到了你的老同伴 Katrina ，她看起來只比你上次造訪時見到她稍微老了一點。
npc_katrina.ref_en_text: Hello again, Avatar!" Katrina greets you with a smile.

npc_kessler.voice_desc_en: Male, elderly, authoritative older man, dignified concerned voice
npc_kessler.voice_desc_zh: 男性，老人，權威的老人，威嚴關切的，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_kessler.ref_zh_text: 你看到一位看起來非常有權威的年長男人，正帶著深思熟慮的關切看著你。
npc_kessler.ref_en_text: You see a very authoritative-looking older man who looks at you with thoughtful concern.

npc_kissme.voice_desc_en: Female, fairy, high-pitched tinkling voice, playful and giggly, singsong quality
npc_kissme.voice_desc_zh: 女，高亢叮噹，俏皮傻笑，歌聲品質，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_kissme.ref_zh_text: 這個活潑的小仙子 (fairy) 在你周圍飛舞，咯咯笑著在你的頭上撒下某種閃閃發光的粉末。
npc_kissme.ref_en_text: I love thee! Yes, I do! I love thee!

npc_kliftin.voice_desc_en: Male, elderly, scarred veteran, gruff experienced voice
npc_kliftin.voice_desc_zh: 男性，年長，傷痕累累的退伍軍人，粗魯經驗豐富的，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_kliftin.ref_zh_text: 你看到一個身經百戰、滿佈傷痕的老兵。
npc_kliftin.ref_en_text: You see a battle-scarred old soldier.

npc_klog.voice_desc_en: Male, 40s, friendly shopkeeper, warm and welcoming voice, cheerful
npc_klog.voice_desc_zh: 男性，40多歲，熱情好客，個性開朗，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_klog.ref_zh_text: 這個男人散發著友善和親切的氣息。「啊，聖者！我一眼就認出你了！消息在鎮上傳得很快。我已經聽說你在這裡了。
npc_klog.ref_en_text: Hello again, Avatar," Klog asks. "How may I help thee?

npc_lap_lem.voice_desc_zh: 男性，微笑友善的，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_lap_lem.ref_zh_text: 這隻石像鬼以微笑迎接你。
npc_lap_lem.ref_en_text: You are greeted with a smile from this gargoyle.

npc_lasher.voice_desc_en: Male, unicorn, noble and wise voice, clear and articulate, magical quality
npc_lasher.voice_desc_zh: 男，高貴睿智的清晰能說，神奇品質，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_lasher.ref_zh_text: 你看到一隻大小和形狀都像馬的生物。牠的頭上長著一根筆直的角。牠用閃爍著智慧光芒的眼睛看著你。
npc_lasher.ref_en_text: I greet thee once again, Avatar," says Lasher, the unicorn.

npc_leavell.voice_desc_en: Male, 20s, knife-juggler, dangerous calm voice, focused
npc_leavell.voice_desc_zh: 男性，20多歲，危險平靜的專注，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_leavell.ref_zh_text: 你看到一個年輕人在指尖上平衡著一把匕首。他努力想忽視你。
npc_leavell.ref_en_text: You see a young man balancing a dagger on the tip of his finger. He tries hard to ignore you.

npc_lord_british.voice_desc_en: Male, elderly, regal and authoritative king, deep resonant voice, dignified and measured pace
npc_lord_british.voice_desc_zh: 男性，老人，低沉，步伐威嚴，穩重，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_lord_british.ref_zh_text: 「當然，這也許可以看作是解決我們所有問題的聰明辦法。畢竟，現在就連那個所謂的守護者也不會想要 Britannia 了！

npc_lord_heather.voice_desc_en: Male, 40s-50s, lordly politician, charming public voice
npc_lord_heather.voice_desc_zh: 男性，40-50歲，迷人的公眾，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_lord_heather.ref_zh_text: 這位充滿王者風範的紳士完美詮釋了一位受歡迎的政治家。
npc_lord_heather.ref_en_text: This regal gentleman epitomizes a well-liked politician.

npc_lucky.voice_desc_en: Male, 30s-40s, steel-muscled pirate, confident smug voice
npc_lucky.voice_desc_zh: 男性，30-40歲，自信得意的，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_lucky.ref_zh_text: 你看到一個肌肉如鋼鐵般結實的男人。他眼中的閃光告訴你他絕不是傻瓜。
npc_lucky.ref_en_text: You see a man whose sinewy body is like steel. The glint in his eye tells you that he is no fool.

npc_lucy.voice_desc_en: Female, 50s, charming older woman, warm welcoming voice, excited
npc_lucy.voice_desc_zh: 女性，50多歲，熱情歡迎的興奮，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_lucy.ref_zh_text: 你看見一位五十多歲、頗具魅力的女人。她帶著溫暖的微笑。「歡迎！陌生人，你是誰？
npc_lucy.ref_en_text: You see an attractive woman in her fifties. She has a warm smile. "Welcome! Who art thou, stranger?

npc_mack.voice_desc_en: Male, 40s, excited farmer, wild-eyed enthusiastic voice
npc_mack.voice_desc_zh: 男性，40多歲，眼神狂熱熱情的，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_mack.ref_zh_text: 你看見一位農夫，狂野的雙眼因為興奮而睜得大大的。
npc_mack.ref_en_text: You see a farmer with wild eyes widened in excitement.

npc_magenta.voice_desc_en: Female, elderly, humble old woman, soft friendly voice
npc_magenta.voice_desc_zh: 女性，年長，謙虛，溫柔友善的，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_magenta.ref_zh_text: 你看到一位看起來很謙虛的年長婦女。她對你露出友好的微笑。
npc_magenta.ref_en_text: You see a humble-looking older woman. She gives you a friendly smile.

npc_malloy.voice_desc_en: Male, 40s, pompous miner, self-important voice, grand speech
npc_malloy.voice_desc_zh: 男性，40多歲，自以為是的豪言壯語，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_malloy.ref_zh_text: 你看到面前站著一個矮胖的男人，臉上帶著自命不凡的傻笑。他一手拿著燈籠，另一手拿著一把髒湯匙。
npc_malloy.ref_en_text: Hello, good friend," says Malloy. "A pleasure to see thee again.

npc_mandy.voice_desc_en: Female, 50s, tough barmaid, rough but motherly voice, no-nonsense
npc_mandy.voice_desc_zh: 女性，50多歲，粗獷但充滿母性，嚴肅，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_mandy.ref_zh_text: 你看到一位五十多歲的女人，她早年可能是個海盜侍女。雖然她很粗野，但她有一種特別的母性特質。

npc_margareta.voice_desc_en: Female, 20s-30s, gypsy, wise mysterious voice, deep knowing tone
npc_margareta.voice_desc_zh: 女性，20-30歲，睿智神秘的深沉會意的語氣，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_margareta.ref_zh_text: 你看到一位年輕迷人的吉普賽女人，有著充滿智慧、彷彿能看穿靈魂的雙眼。
npc_margareta.ref_en_text: You see a young, bewitching gypsy woman with wise, soul-peering eyes.

npc_mariah.voice_desc_en: Female, 30s, mage companion, clever voice with a hint of slyness
npc_mariah.voice_desc_zh: 女，30多歲，聰明的帶著一絲狡黠的，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_mariah.ref_zh_text: 你看到你的老朋友 Mariah 。
npc_mariah.ref_en_text: You see your old friend Mariah.

npc_markham.voice_desc_en: Male, ghost, fat ghost, pained and disoriented voice, groaning
npc_markham.voice_desc_zh: 男，鬼，痛苦迷失的呻吟，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_markham.ref_zh_text: 這名不死生物空洞的目光，望向了你。顯然它察覺到了你的存在，但是你非常確定它並未看見你。
npc_markham.ref_en_text: He begins to rub his temples with both hands.

npc_martine.voice_desc_en: Female, 20s, tropical bath attendant, warm exotic voice, professional
npc_martine.voice_desc_zh: 女，20多歲，溫暖的異國專業，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_martine.ref_zh_text: 這位女士驚訝地抬頭說：「我現在沒在工作，我請求你尊重我的隱私。如果你想和我說話，請在深夜時分到澡堂來。
npc_martine.ref_en_text: You see a beautiful young woman with a tropical air.

npc_martingo.voice_desc_en: Male, 40s, insane nobleman, intense and unsettling voice, cultured but unstable
npc_martingo.voice_desc_zh: 男性，40多歲，緊張而令人不安，有教養但不穩定，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_martingo.ref_zh_text: 你看到一位貴族，獨自一人，眼中閃爍著瘋狂的光芒。
npc_martingo.ref_en_text: You see a nobleman, all alone, with a demented gleam in his eye.

npc_miranda.voice_desc_en: Female, 20s-30s, warm country woman, friendly and welcoming voice
npc_miranda.voice_desc_zh: 女性，20-30歲，熱情的鄉村婦女，友善熱情，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_miranda.ref_zh_text: 這是一位可愛、樸實，帶著溫暖笑容的女性。
npc_miranda.ref_en_text: This is a lovely, earthy woman with a warm smile.

npc_mole.voice_desc_en: Male, elderly, old pirate, raspy aging voice
npc_mole.voice_desc_zh: 男性，老人，沙啞蒼老的，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_mole.ref_zh_text: 你看到一位老海盜，他曾經可能看起來極其危險。
npc_mole.ref_en_text: You see an aging pirate who might have looked extremely dangerous at one time.

npc_mordra.voice_desc_en: Female, elderly, grandmotherly ghost, gentle humming voice, warm but distant
npc_mordra.voice_desc_zh: 女，老人，溫柔的哼哼聲，溫暖卻又遙遠，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_mordra.ref_zh_text: 這位年老的幽靈婦女哼著一首古老民謠的曲調，並抬起頭對你微笑。這位老婦人會讓你想起你見過的每一位祖母。
npc_mordra.ref_en_text: Hello, milord. Thou mayest call me Mistress Mordra." She peers at you closely.

npc_morfin.voice_desc_en: Male, 40s, grumpy merchant, gruff and irritable voice, impatient tone
npc_morfin.voice_desc_zh: 男性，40多歲，粗暴易怒，語氣不耐煩，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_morfin.ref_zh_text: 你看到一個男人，他的眼珠慢慢地轉來轉去，嘴角掛著狡黠的微笑。他走到你面前，上下打量著你。「喔，鎮上一定有巡迴表演！」他竊笑著說。「那是一件非常棒的小丑裝！你是誰？
npc_morfin.ref_en_text: Very well, Avatar. What dost thou want?

npc_nastassia.voice_desc_en: Female, 20s, sad beautiful young woman, soft melancholy voice, delicate and sorrowful
npc_nastassia.voice_desc_zh: 女性，20多歲，悲傷美麗，柔和憂鬱的細膩而悲傷，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_nastassia.ref_zh_text: 這是一位年輕迷人的女性，但神情似乎有些哀傷。
npc_nastassia.ref_en_text: This is an attractive young woman who seems sad.

npc_nelson.voice_desc_en: Male, 30s-40s, scholarly man, friendly intellectual voice
npc_nelson.voice_desc_zh: 男性，30-40歲，友善的知性，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_nelson.ref_zh_text: 你看到一位看起來很博學的男人，帶著友善的表情。
npc_nelson.ref_en_text: You see a scholarly-looking man with a friendly expression.

npc_nicodemus.voice_desc_en: Male, elderly, senile mage, shaky and confused voice, muttering, eccentric and forgetful
npc_nicodemus.voice_desc_zh: 男性，年老，顫抖混亂，喃喃自語，古怪健忘，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_nicodemus.ref_zh_text: 你的老朋友 Nicodemus 的眼神顯得很遙遠。
npc_nicodemus.ref_en_text: Your old friend Nicodemus has a far away look in his eyes.

npc_nystul.voice_desc_en: Male, elderly, aged wizard, distracted and contemplative voice
npc_nystul.voice_desc_zh: 男性，年長，心煩意亂和沈思的，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_nystul.ref_zh_text: 你看到你的老朋友 Nystul ，現在是一位穿著法師長袍、衰老的長者。他似乎陷入了沉思，神遊物外。
npc_nystul.ref_en_text: Do I know thee?" Nystul asks.

npc_ophelia.voice_desc_en: Female, 20s, shy and kind young woman, soft gentle voice, sweet and warm
npc_ophelia.voice_desc_zh: 女，20多歲，害羞善良，溫柔，甜美溫暖，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_ophelia.ref_zh_text: 一位漂亮的女人對你露出友好的笑容，然後羞怯地將目光移開。
npc_ophelia.ref_en_text: A pretty woman gives you a friendly grin and then coyly turns her eyes away from you.

npc_owen.voice_desc_en: Male, 20s, serious young nobleman, earnest and formal voice
npc_owen.voice_desc_zh: 男性，20多歲，認真正式，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_owen.ref_zh_text: Owen 不會中斷他參與友誼會的集會來和你說話。
npc_owen.ref_en_text: Owen will not interrupt his participation in The Fellowship meeting to talk with you.

npc_owings.voice_desc_en: Male, 40s, skinny miner, friendly simple voice, grinning
npc_owings.voice_desc_zh: 男性，40多歲，友善簡單，笑容可掬，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_owings.ref_zh_text: 在你面前的是個骨瘦如柴的男人，臉上帶著傻笑。他一手拿著燈籠，另一手拿著一把髒湯匙。
npc_owings.ref_en_text: Hello, again," says Owings. He smiles and tips his mining hat to you.

npc_papa.voice_desc_en: Male, 40s-50s, wild naked man, rough primal voice, baffled
npc_papa.voice_desc_zh: 男性，40-50歲，粗糙的原始困惑，用標準的普通話朗讀

npc_patterson.voice_desc_en: Male, 30s-40s, concerned fellowship member, worried and distracted voice
npc_patterson.voice_desc_zh: 男性，30-40歲，關心的擔憂而心煩意亂的，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_patterson.ref_zh_text: Patterson 正專心參與友誼會聚會，不想說話。
npc_patterson.ref_en_text: Patterson is concentrating on the Fellowship meeting and does not wish to speak.

npc_paul.voice_desc_en: Male, 20s, cheerful young performer, bright and energetic voice
npc_paul.voice_desc_zh: 男性，20多歲，明亮充滿活力，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_paul.ref_zh_text: 你看到一個年輕的表演者向你招手。
npc_paul.ref_en_text: You see a young entertainer who beckons to you.

npc_paulette.voice_desc_en: Female, 20s, beautiful barmaid ghost, dreamy distant voice, confused
npc_paulette.voice_desc_zh: 女，20多歲，夢幻般遙遠的困惑，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_paulette.ref_zh_text: 美麗的幻影繼續她的工作，沒有提供任何回應。
npc_paulette.ref_en_text: The lovely apparition goes about her tasks without offering any response.

npc_penumbra.voice_desc_en: Female, 30s-40s, powerful mage, confident and intense voice, slightly dramatic
npc_penumbra.voice_desc_zh: 女性，30-40歲，自信而激烈略帶戲劇性的，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_penumbra.ref_zh_text: 這位沉睡了 200 年的法師看起來就像你上次造訪 Britannia 時一樣。
npc_penumbra.ref_en_text: Avatar! I cannot believe 'tis thee! Thou didst come and wake me! I knew thee would!

npc_petre.voice_desc_en: Male, 40s, terrified farmer, frightened stammering voice
npc_petre.voice_desc_zh: 男性，40 多歲，害怕的結巴，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_petre.ref_zh_text: 這位農夫看著你，像大白天撞見鬼。「Iolo！這那個人就這樣憑空冒出來！救命啊！
npc_petre.ref_en_text: You see a distraught peasant. "Art thou really the Avatar?

npc_phearcy.voice_desc_en: Male, 30s-40s, polite but busy fellowship member, hurried and slightly distracted
npc_phearcy.voice_desc_zh: 男性，30-40歲，有禮貌但忙碌的匆忙且有點心不在焉，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_phearcy.ref_zh_text: 抱歉，大人，我晚點再跟你聊。但我現在想專心開會。
npc_phearcy.ref_en_text: Sorry, milord, I may talk to thee later. But now I wish to pay attention to the meeting.

npc_quaeven.voice_desc_en: Male, gargoyle, hurried fellowship member, rushed distracted voice
npc_quaeven.voice_desc_zh: 男性，匆忙心煩意亂的，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_quaeven.ref_zh_text: 現在沒時間說話。會議結束後再談。
npc_quaeven.ref_en_text: To have not the time to speak now. To talk after meeting.

npc_quan.voice_desc_en: Male, gargoyle, dignified but busy, formal polite voice
npc_quan.voice_desc_zh: 男性，威嚴但忙碌，正式禮貌的，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_quan.ref_zh_text: 這隻石像鬼似乎忙著主持友誼會會議，現在沒空跟你說話。
npc_quan.ref_en_text: The gargoyle seems to be too busy conducting the Fellowship meeting to speak with you now.

npc_quenton.voice_desc_en: Male, ghost, weak fading voice, apologetic and confused, barely audible
npc_quenton.voice_desc_zh: 男，鬼，微弱，帶著歉意和困惑，幾乎聽不見，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_quenton.ref_zh_text: 蒼白的幽靈似乎看到了你，但出於某種原因無法對你說話。幽靈沮喪地轉過身去。
npc_quenton.ref_en_text: Hello, Quenton. I hope thou art doing well." Rowena gives the pale ghost a winning smile.

npc_rankin.voice_desc_en: Male, 40s, friendly fellowship leader, warm and welcoming voice
npc_rankin.voice_desc_zh: 男性，40多歲，友善的熱情好客，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_rankin.ref_zh_text: Rankin 現在無法與你交談，因為他正在主持友誼會的聚會。
npc_rankin.ref_en_text: Rankin is unable to speak with you now, for he is conducting the Fellowship meeting.

npc_raymundo.voice_desc_en: Male, 40s, irritable artist, annoyed and dismissive voice, creative intensity
npc_raymundo.voice_desc_zh: 男性，40 多歲，惱怒且輕蔑的創作強度，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_raymundo.ref_zh_text: 你可以看到這個人的創造力，源源不絕地湧現出來。他饒富興味地看著你。
npc_raymundo.ref_en_text: Yes, yes?" Raymundo snaps. "What dost thou want? I'm busy!

npc_reyna.voice_desc_en: Female, 20s-30s, bright-eyed woman, cheerful and lively voice
npc_reyna.voice_desc_zh: 女性，20-30歲，眼睛明亮，開朗活潑，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_reyna.ref_zh_text: 這個女人閃著明亮的眼睛跟你打招呼。
npc_reyna.ref_en_text: The woman greets you with shining eyes.

npc_richter.voice_desc_en: Male, 20s-30s, gallant knight, confident and polite voice
npc_richter.voice_desc_zh: 男性，20-30歲，自信而有禮貌的，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_richter.ref_zh_text: 你看到一位瀟灑的年輕人，他轉身向你問候。
npc_richter.ref_en_text: You see a dashing young man, who turns to greet you.

npc_roberto.voice_desc_en: Male, 20s-30s, extremely handsome bath attendant, warm professional voice
npc_roberto.voice_desc_zh: 男性，20-30歲，溫暖專業的，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_roberto.ref_zh_text: 這個男人驚訝地抬頭說：「我現在沒在工作，我請求你尊重我的隱私。如果你想和我說話，請在深夜時分到澡堂來。
npc_roberto.ref_en_text: You see a strikingly handsome man with eyes that pierce your soul.

npc_robin.voice_desc_en: Male, 20s-30s, roguish charming man, laid-back voice, hint of mischief
npc_robin.voice_desc_zh: 男性，20-30歲，浪蕩魅力男，悠閒，帶著一絲惡作劇的味道，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_robin.ref_zh_text: 你看到一個流氓般的男人，穿著似乎是某個貴族破舊的二手衣服。
npc_robin.ref_en_text: You see a roguish man dressed in what appears to be some nobleman's ratty hand-me-downs.

npc_rowena.voice_desc_en: Female, 30s-40s, ghostly lady, hollow distant voice, polite but detached
npc_rowena.voice_desc_zh: 女性，30-40歲，空洞遙遠的禮貌但超然，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_rowena.ref_zh_text: 美麗的鬼魂眼神空洞地看著你。你做的任何事似乎都無法引起她的注意。

npc_rudyom.voice_desc_en: Male, elderly, senile old mage, forgetful shaky voice
npc_rudyom.voice_desc_zh: 男性，老人，健忘，顫抖，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_rudyom.ref_zh_text: 這位年邁的法師看起來比你上次見到他時還要衰老且更加健忘。
npc_rudyom.ref_en_text: This elderly mage looks older and more senile than when you last saw him.

npc_runeb.voice_desc_zh: 男性，皺眉不耐煩的，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_runeb.ref_zh_text: 這隻石像鬼皺著眉頭轉向你。他將巨大的手移到嘴邊，用一根手指抵住嘴唇。友誼會會議正在進行中。
npc_runeb.ref_en_text: The gargoyle, obviously in a hurry, ignores you.

npc_russell.voice_desc_en: Male, 40s, content shipwright, calm satisfied voice
npc_russell.voice_desc_zh: 男性，40多歲，平靜滿意的，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_russell.ref_zh_text: 在你面前的是一位看起來很精明的工匠，顯然對平靜的生活充滿滿足感。
npc_russell.ref_en_text: Before you is a shrewd-looking craftsman, obviously filled with the contentment of a peaceful life.

npc_rutherford.voice_desc_en: Male, 40s, tired one-armed man, weary but friendly voice
npc_rutherford.voice_desc_zh: 男性，40多歲，疲憊但友善，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_rutherford.ref_zh_text: 你看到一個神情疲憊、失去右臂的男人。他用單手抓了抓頭，朝你的方向瞇起眼睛。
npc_rutherford.ref_en_text: Oy, how ye been, milord?" Rutherford calls out to you.

npc_salamon.voice_desc_en: Female, elderly, withered female ape-creature, creaky old voice
npc_salamon.voice_desc_zh: 女性，年長，沙啞蒼老，用標準的普通話朗讀

npc_sam.voice_desc_en: Male, 40s, content florist, warm gentle voice, happy
npc_sam.voice_desc_zh: 男性，40多歲，溫暖溫柔，快樂，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_sam.ref_zh_text: 你看到一位看起來很滿足的蓄鬍男子，臉上有著深深的笑紋和溫柔的雙眼。
npc_sam.ref_en_text: You see a content-looking bearded man, with deep-set laugh lines in his face and gentle eyes.

npc_saralek.voice_desc_en: Female, female ape-creature, nervous skittish voice
npc_saralek.voice_desc_zh: 女性，緊張不安的，用標準的普通話朗讀

npc_sarpling.voice_desc_en: Male, gargoyle, distracted fellowship member, hurried voice
npc_sarpling.voice_desc_zh: 男性，心煩意亂的匆忙的，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_sarpling.ref_zh_text: 這隻石像鬼正全神貫注於友誼會會議，現在沒空跟你說話。
npc_sarpling.ref_en_text: The gargoyle is too involved with the Fellowship meeting to talk to you at this moment.

npc_sean.voice_desc_en: Male, 30s-40s, concerned fellowship member, distracted voice
npc_sean.voice_desc_zh: 男性，30-40歲，憂心忡忡的心不在焉，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_sean.ref_zh_text: Sean 全神貫注地聽著友誼會的集會。
npc_sean.ref_en_text: Sean is deep in concentration, listening to the Fellowship meeting.

npc_sentri.voice_desc_en: Male, 20s-30s, stylish fencer, confident and smooth voice
npc_sentri.voice_desc_zh: 男性，20-30歲，自信流暢，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_sentri.ref_zh_text: 你看到一個瀟灑、苗條、穿著時髦且非常有品味的男人。
npc_sentri.ref_en_text: You see a dashing, slender man, stylishly dressed, with a lot of flair.

npc_shamino.voice_desc_en: Male, 40s, mysterious ranger, calm and measured voice with a hint of wisdom and melancholy
npc_shamino.voice_desc_zh: 男性，40多歲，平靜而有分寸，帶著一絲睿智和憂鬱，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_shamino.ref_zh_text: 抱歉，我不加入小偷的行列。
npc_shamino.ref_en_text: I am sorry, I do not join thieves.

npc_sherry.voice_desc_en: Female, rat, squeaky intelligent voice, excited and friendly
npc_sherry.voice_desc_zh: 女性，吱吱的智慧興奮而友好，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_sherry.ref_zh_text: 你看見一隻非常巨大的老鼠，散發出一種卓越智慧的氣息。
npc_sherry.ref_en_text: You see a very large mouse with an air of superior intelligence.

npc_shrine.voice_desc_en: Entity, shrine spirit, echoing reverent voice, divine quality
npc_shrine.voice_desc_zh: 中性，虔誠而神聖的，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_shrine.ref_zh_text: 我們感謝你，聖者。你拯救了 Britannia 免於陷入可能的第二次黑暗時代。你再次證明了你作為 Lord British 意志體現者的價值。
npc_shrine.ref_en_text: Suddenly, your mind is filled with the crystal-clear resonance of an authoritative voice.

npc_silamo.voice_desc_zh: 男性，皺眉的正式，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_silamo.ref_zh_text: 你看到一隻皺著眉頭的石像鬼。

npc_smith.voice_desc_en: Male, horse, simple direct voice, dry humor, equine snorts
npc_smith.voice_desc_zh: 男，簡單直接的冷幽默，噴鼻息，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_smith.ref_zh_text: 你看到一匹馬。「你還期待看到什麼？
npc_smith.ref_en_text: You see a horse. "What else did you expect to see?

npc_smithy.voice_desc_zh: 男性，30-40歲，流暢，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_smithy.ref_zh_text: 你看到一個衣著考究，頭髮塗著油的海盜。
npc_smithy.ref_en_text: You see a well-dressed pirate with oil in his hair.

npc_snaz.voice_desc_en: Male, 30s-40s, crafty beggar, rough voice with a wheedling tone, false friendliness
npc_snaz.voice_desc_zh: 男性，30-40歲，粗聲粗氣，語氣哄騙，虛假友善，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_snaz.ref_zh_text: 你看見一個渾身髒兮兮的乞丐，他對你咧嘴一笑，彷彿你是他全世界最好的朋友。

npc_spark.voice_desc_en: Male, teenage boy, earnest and emotional, voice cracking with adolescence, slightly insecure
npc_spark.voice_desc_zh: 男性，十幾歲的男孩，認真而情緒化，青春期時聲音嘶啞，有點不安全感，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_spark.ref_zh_text: 你得找個鐵匠來做那件事。我敢打賭我爸能做到……我的意思是，如果他還活著，他就能做到……
npc_spark.ref_en_text: Who art thou and what dost thou want?" You realize the boy has a sling in hand.

npc_sprellic.voice_desc_en: Male, young adult, timid and fearful, high-pitched nervous voice, stammers slightly
npc_sprellic.voice_desc_zh: 男性，青年，膽怯害怕，緊張，輕微結巴，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_sprellic.ref_zh_text: 你看到一個骨瘦如柴且看起來膽小的男人，他恐懼地看著你。
npc_sprellic.ref_en_text: You see a scrawny and timid-looking man who eyes you fearfully.

npc_stone_guardian.voice_desc_en: Male, elemental, deep rumbling stone voice, slow and wise
npc_stone_guardian.voice_desc_zh: 男性，深沉的隆隆石聲，緩慢而睿智，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_stone_guardian.ref_zh_text: 是的，休息吧，我的朋友。休息並療傷，這樣你才能變得堅強，並有能力面對你眼前的危險。祝你有個好夢！
npc_stone_guardian.ref_en_text: Go inside. Tell them you are the Avatar!

npc_sullivan.voice_desc_en: Male, 20s-30s, cheerful ex-convict, bright and grateful voice
npc_sullivan.voice_desc_zh: 男性，20-30歲，明亮而感恩，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_sullivan.ref_zh_text: 你把我從牢房裡放出來真是太好了。我現在要回到我以前的生活。日安！
npc_sullivan.ref_en_text: 'Twas very kind of thee to release me from my cell. I shall now return to my former life. Good day!

npc_tavenor.voice_desc_zh: 男性，謹慎小心的，用標準的普通話朗讀

npc_taylor.voice_desc_en: Male, 20s-30s, hard-working man, polite efficient voice
npc_taylor.voice_desc_zh: 男性，20-30歲，工作勤奮，禮貌高效，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_taylor.ref_zh_text: 你看到一個有魅力、看起來很用功的男人。
npc_taylor.ref_en_text: You see an attractive, studious-looking man.

npc_teregus.voice_desc_en: Male, gargoyle, dignified and formal, slightly gravelly but hospitable tone
npc_teregus.voice_desc_zh: 男性，端莊正式，語氣略顯沙啞但好客，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_teregus.ref_zh_text: 你看到一隻正值壯年的有翼石像鬼。
npc_teregus.ref_en_text: You see a winged gargoyle in his physical prime.

npc_time_lord.voice_desc_en: Male, ancient being, timeless and mysterious voice, deep resonant tone with otherworldly echo
npc_time_lord.voice_desc_zh: 男性，古老的存在，永恆而神秘的深沉的共鳴，超凡脫俗的迴聲，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_time_lord.ref_zh_text: 恭喜你，聖者，摧毀了球體。我從我的天球監獄中解脫了。我感謝你。但我很遺憾地通知你，守護者設計了那個球體，它的毀滅永久地癱瘓了月之門，以及你的月之寶珠。你無法再透過紅色的月之門回到你的家鄉了。
npc_time_lord.ref_en_text: Shouldst thou wish to speak with me again, simply use the hourglass. Goodbye.

npc_tobias.voice_desc_en: Male, teen-20s, sullen young man, resentful muttering voice
npc_tobias.voice_desc_zh: 男性，20多歲，悶悶不樂，怨恨的嘀咕聲，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_tobias.ref_zh_text: 你看到一個生悶氣的小伙子，他似乎不想直視你的眼睛。
npc_tobias.ref_en_text: You see a sulking lad, who doesn't seem to want to look you in the eye.

npc_tory.voice_desc_en: Female, 40s, compassionate healer, warm and understanding voice
npc_tory.voice_desc_zh: 女性，40多歲，富有同情心，溫暖善解人意，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_tory.ref_en_text: The woman smiles at you compassionately.

npc_trellek.voice_desc_en: Male, ape-like creature, simple cautious voice, slow and deliberate
npc_trellek.voice_desc_zh: 男性，簡單謹慎，緩慢而從容，用標準的普通話朗讀

npc_trent.voice_desc_en: Male, 40s, vengeful inventor, intense and determined voice, obsessive
npc_trent.voice_desc_zh: 男性，40多歲，強烈而堅定，有強迫症，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_trent.ref_zh_text: Trent 瞪著你，他的眼神中透露出一種強烈的情感，讓你對他的態度毫不懷疑。「如果我認為你會在接到通知的那一刻就跑掉，我就不會請求你幫我救出我的摯愛了。
npc_trent.ref_en_text: The large, angry-looking ghost ignores your presence, while obviously searching for some item.

npc_tseramed.voice_desc_en: Male, 30s-40s, serious ranger, steady and grounded voice, speaks plainly with a hint of wilderness grit
npc_tseramed.voice_desc_zh: 男性，30-40歲，沉穩踏實，說話平穩，帶著一絲荒野的堅毅，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_tseramed.ref_zh_text: 我們不必擔心這些蜜蜂，只要我們有幾支我可靠的箭。
npc_tseramed.ref_en_text: We need not be concerned about these bees, so long as we have a number of my trusty arrows.

npc_unknown.voice_desc_en: Neutral, clear and calm narrator voice, articulate and unhurried, descriptive tone
npc_unknown.voice_desc_zh: 敘述者聲音中性、清晰、平靜，口齒清晰、不緊不慢、描述語氣，用標準的普通話朗讀

npc_wench.voice_desc_en: Female, 20s, attractive bath attendant, sultry voice, professional warmth
npc_wench.voice_desc_zh: 女，20多歲，性感，專業溫暖，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_wench.ref_zh_text: 這位女士驚訝地抬頭說：「我現在沒在工作，我請求你尊重我的隱私。如果你想和我說話，請在深夜時分到澡堂來。
npc_wench.ref_en_text: You see a gorgeous young woman with seductive eyes.

npc_weston.voice_desc_en: Male, 20s, hopeless young prisoner, defeated sad voice
npc_weston.voice_desc_zh: 男性，20多歲，失敗的悲傷，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_weston.ref_zh_text: 你看見一個徹底灰心喪志的年輕人，正在鐵窗後痛苦地憔悴著。
npc_weston.ref_en_text: You see a thoroughly disheartened young man who is miserably languishing behind bars.

npc_willy.voice_desc_en: Male, 20s, enthusiastic young man, eager and friendly voice, slightly nerdy
npc_willy.voice_desc_zh: 男性，20多歲，熱情，熱切友善，略帶書呆子氣，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_willy.ref_zh_text: 你看見一個看起來很愛乾淨、胖乎乎的年輕人，正瘋狂地向你揮手。
npc_willy.ref_en_text: You see a very clean-looking, portly young man who waves at you frantically.

npc_wis_sur.voice_desc_en: Male, gargoyle, authoritative winged gargoyle, formal commanding voice
npc_wis_sur.voice_desc_zh: 男性，正式的指揮，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_wis_sur.ref_zh_text: 你看到一只有翼石像鬼，帶著權威的氣質。
npc_wis_sur.ref_en_text: You see a winged gargoyle with an authoritative disposition.

npc_wislem.voice_desc_zh: 男性，威嚴令人印象深刻，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_wislem.ref_zh_text: 你看見一隻令人印象深刻，舉止莊嚴的有翼石像鬼。
npc_wislem.ref_en_text: You see an impressive winged gargoyle with a stately demeanor.

npc_xorinia.voice_desc_en: Entity, will-o-wisp, alien echoing voice, strange cadence, collective we-speech
npc_xorinia.voice_desc_zh: 中性，外星人的迴響、奇怪的節奏、集體的我們言語，用標準的普通話朗讀

npc_yvella.voice_desc_en: Female, 20s, polite young housewife, soft courteous voice
npc_yvella.voice_desc_zh: 女，20多歲，溫柔有禮的，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_yvella.ref_zh_text: 你看到的這位主婦臉上帶著擔憂的表情。
npc_yvella.ref_en_text: The matronly woman you see has a look of concern on her face.

npc_zelda.voice_desc_en: Female, 30s-40s, cold woman, icy clipped voice
npc_zelda.voice_desc_zh: 女性，30-40歲，冷酷的女人，冰冷的，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_zelda.ref_zh_text: 你看到一位用冰冷目光迎接你視線的女人。
npc_zelda.ref_en_text: You see a woman who meets your gaze with an icy stare.

npc_zorn.voice_desc_en: Male, 40s, exhausted blacksmith, grim and tired voice
npc_zorn.voice_desc_zh: 男性，40多歲，嚴峻疲憊，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_zorn.ref_zh_text: 你看到一個男人，長時間悶熱而艱苦的工作讓他的臉凝固成僵硬的表情，眼睛像熾熱的煤炭。
npc_zorn.ref_en_text: How may I serve thee?" says Zorn.
